author: marketing_c
protectedRevelations: Engineering prescriptions and full assurance framework

scenes.title: The score passed
scenes.viewerPurpose: Picture a high-scoring AI letting someone down Ask what trust requires in everyday use
scenes.composition: A favorable evaluation sits beside an unsupported user answer
addOrChange: Add a benchmark report without invented numbers or harm.

cues.narration: The benchmark looks excellent; the system still fails the person relying on it.
cues.visualAction: Compare favorable testing with an answer that lacks needed support.

cues.narration: Trustworthy AI explores what it takes to justify that reliance in real work.
cues.visualAction: The engineer and reviewer inspect the actual use context.

scenes.title: The evidence behind an answer
scenes.viewerPurpose: Follow a familiar assistant as its responsibilities grow Notice a correct answer alongside a privacy failure
scenes.composition: An answer is traced to its source and permissions
addOrChange: Add a private-source marker and unresolved uncertainty, removing duplicated drafts.

cues.narration: It follows an everyday assistant as new information, tools, and permissions change what could go wrong.
cues.visualAction: Introduce new data and tool access beside the same assistant.

cues.narration: An answer can be right while the system leaks private information or hides an important doubt.
cues.visualAction: Keep useful content visible while its privacy or uncertainty problem appears.

scenes.title: A changing system
scenes.viewerPurpose: See why the same model may suit one task but not another
scenes.composition: The same model enters two different use contexts
addOrChange: Contrast drafting with a consequential decision without claiming either certified safe.

cues.narration: The same model can support one decision and be unsuitable for another.
cues.visualAction: Keep the model fixed while data, user and stakes change.

scenes.title: The release decision
scenes.viewerPurpose: Ask whether a failed test can change a release decision
scenes.composition: A failed check reaches the release decision
addOrChange: Keep the control pauseable and the record open, with no automatic approval.

cues.narration: A test matters when its result can change what the system is allowed to do.
cues.visualAction: Bring the failed check directly beside the release control.

scenes.title: Reliance you can examine
scenes.viewerPurpose: Think about an AI acting on your behalf Want evidence strong enough to support that trust
scenes.composition: A reader examines the claim’s intended use and evidence
addOrChange: Reduce hands and badges to three short fields and an unanswered risk.

cues.narration: If an AI will act for you, this book asks what you should know before trusting it.
cues.visualAction: The reader checks the claim before delegating a task.

cues.narration: Before an AI acts for someone, what should that promise be able to withstand?
cues.visualAction: Hold the promise beside its still-open test record.
